title: GraphQL leaks its schema through field suggestions
summary: With introspection off, the API still answers an unknown field with a suggestion of the real one, so the schema can be rebuilt a field at a time.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("Did you mean") and body_contains("Cannot query field")

remediate: Turn field suggestions off in production as well as introspection.
